1477-3139-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-3139-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
1477-3139-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing The Great Henge, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

147-728-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-728-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

7675-7676-8100.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Elven Passage.
7675-7676-8100.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Elven Passage.
When Elven Passage enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Elven Passage by tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

2111-4981-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3789-3899-4552-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3789-3899-4552-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

855-3099-4762-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
855-3099-4762-7803.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Corpsejack Menace and Brad Boimler.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

5191-7352.easyPrerequisites:
A player controls another non-Wall creature with toughness equal to 1.
A player controls another non-Wall creature with toughness equal to 2.
5191-7352.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause another creature to die.
You have a way to give Raptor Hatchling indestructible.
5191-7352.description:
Give Raptor Hatchling indestructible.
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}. When it enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Raptor Hatchling.
Raptor Hatchling triggers, creating a 3/3 Dinosaur creature token.
Cause another creature to die.
When the creature dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature. This will cause the creature with toughness equal to 1 to die.
Raptor Hatchling and Electric Seaweed trigger.
Resolve the Raptor Hatchling trigger, creating a 3/3 Dinosaur creature token.
Resolve the Electric Seaweed trigger, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature. This will cause the creature with toughness equal to 2 to die.
Raptor Hatchling and Electric Seaweed trigger.
Resolve the Raptor Hatchling trigger, creating a 3/3 Dinosaur creature token.
Resolve the Electric Seaweed trigger, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature. This will cause the oldest Dinosaur token to die.
Repeat from step 10.
5191-7352.notes: Alternatively, either of the creatures with specified toughness can be replaced by an additional instance of a creature dying. The creature that dies in step 5 must not be either of the creatures with specified toughness, or Electric Seaweed or Raptor Hatchling.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4029-4762-4772.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and Benevolent Hydra.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

457-3490-3949.description:
Cast Animation Module by paying {1}.
When Animation Module enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Urza's first ability by tapping an artifact you control, adding {U}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

423-872-907-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-872-907-1437--85.description:
Cast Scaled Herbalist by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Scaled Herbalist spell three times.
Resolve the first Scaled Herbalist copy.
Activate the Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1649-2178-5346.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken artifact creature with mana value 3 or less.
You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
1649-2178-5346.description:
Activate Goblin Engineer by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken artifact creature with mana value 3 or less, targeting another artifact creature with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
When the artifact creature dies, Goblin Engineer and Crime Novelist triggers.
Resolve the Goblin Engineer trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Resolve the Goblin Engineer ability, returning the targeted artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-7175.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

2366-3480-5175-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3480-5175-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1692-2489-3732-4477.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-2489-3732-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-2489-3732-4477.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

341-1017-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

141-313-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-6798.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Artifact / Creature with "{T}: Add Mana" that can tap upon ETB (Mana Rock)

1170-5078-6918--30.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the mana-producing artifact or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking the mana-producing artifact or creature.
Repeat.

339-677-2079-5147.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-6311-6633.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

2558-3490-3698-4050-6701.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-3698-4050-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

560-997-1940-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-997-1940-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Repeat.

338-5296-6081--60.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enougb mana to animate the land (if needed)
338-5296-6081--60.notablePrerequisites: The land has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
338-5296-6081--60.description:
If needed, animate the land, causing it to become a creature.
Cast Light of Promise by paying its mana cost, attaching it to the animated land.
Activate Black Panther by paying {3}, moving all +1/+1 counters from the animated land to Workhorse, then causing you to gain at least 3 life and draw a card.
The animated land triggers, putting at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
338-5296-6081--60.notes: If the land has four or more +1/+1 counters on it, this combo will net near-infinite +1/+1 counters on Workhorse and/or another creature of your choosing.

804-1846-3546-3783-4300.notablePrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
804-1846-3546-3783-4300.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the tapped Island from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate High Market's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion.
When the Illusion dies, Sakashima the Impostor and Minn's second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning High Market from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor and Minn triggers, putting an Island and High Market from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-2897-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Gigantoplasm has a power of at least 2.
2713-2897-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Gigantoplasm and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Gigantoplasm from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Gigantoplasm to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Gigantoplasm enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Gigantoplasm by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

3388-5745-5747.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3388-5745-5747.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Morrite of the Frost's enters-the-battlefield ability and Simulacrum Synthesizer's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Simulacrum Synthesizer trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2692-5478-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2692-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1857-2178-3113.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1857-2178-3113.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1247-5343.notablePrerequisites:
Bigger on the Inside attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5343.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {2} and causing the next spell you cast to have cascade.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Optionally, you may cast any spell to get infinite cascade triggers based off the mana value of that spell.

719-2290-4384.notablePrerequisites:
Spike Feeder has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Halfling" or "Treefolk" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2290-4384.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Treebeard triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Repeat.
Once Spike Feeder has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may target any other creature with Treebeard's ability.

2034-4504-4766.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches, adidng {C}{C}.
Endless Cockroaches dies, triggering itself and Deathrender.
Resolve the Endless Cockroaches trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Endless Cockroaches onto the battlefield from your hand, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

541-544-3634-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Sanctum of Eternity by tapping it and paying {2}, returning Venser from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2484-2615-3587.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
You have enough mana available to cast Blasphemous Act.
2484-2615-3587.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Blasphemous Act, dealing thirteen damage to all creatures.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing thirteen damage to target opponent.
